documents.title: Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board

responsibilities: Developed modules using Angular 16, Java Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL including Profile Update, Application Renewal, Payment Gateway, RBAC, CMS, DMS, and Chat-bot.
Implemented Aadhaar integration (OTP, eKYC, biometric) and biometric device configuration.
Worked on security with Spring Security, JWT, CAPTCHA, encryption, and backend validation.
Designed RBAC with Geo x User x Role Mapping and Role x Menu Mapping; built CMS and DMS modules; integrated payment gateway and transaction logging.
